user_story:
As a user, I want to log into the application using my credentials so that I can access secure areas of the site. 
Acceptance Criteria: 
- The login form should accept a username input field with the selector 'input[id="username"]'. 
- The login form should accept a password input field with the selector 'input[id="password"]'. 
- Upon entering valid credentials (username: 'tomsmith', password: 'SuperSecretPassword!') and clicking the 'Login' button (selector 'button[class="radius"]'), the user should be redirected to a secure area. 
- If the login form is submitted without any credentials, the user should remain on the login page (URL: 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login').
